items: Join the Discord, right from Settings, About Amaviro.
Contact Support emails support@amaviro.app, with your beta number and device filled in.
The website, Privacy Policy and Terms now say who publishes Amaviro and how to get in touch.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
